signals.headline: Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood (FLL) August passengers fell 5.8% to 2,375,538; year-to-date is down 0.8%
signals.fact: Broward County Aviation Department's FLL traffic report (updated for August 2026) shows 2,375,538 total passengers (arriving + departing) in August 2026, down 5.8% from August 2025, and 21,757,164 year-to-date, down 0.8%.
signals.source: Broward County Aviation Department, FLL traffic report (August 2026)
